item.title: Jefferson K-12 Hosts College and Career Readiness Fair to Empower Students’ Futures
item.description: Through presentations, workshops, and networking opportunities, students gained valuable resources and guidance, helping them take confident steps toward their future aspirations.

item.title: Keep Wakulla County Beautiful celebrates America's 250th birthday by cleaning up national forest
item.description: Keep Wakulla County Beautiful is hosting a forest cleanup on March 7. It's part of a nationwide effort to collect 250 billion pounds of trash by July 4th.

item.title: Banana Ball World Tour kicks off in Tallahassee with electric opener at Dick Howser Stadium
item.description: The Banana Ball League opened their 2026 World Tour at Dick Howser Stadium Thursday, with the Loco Beach Coconuts defeating the Firefighters. The Party Animals take on the Clowns Friday at 7 p.m.
